summary: Vodafone Group filed a Form 6-K on 31 July 2026 reporting grants of Global Long-Term Incentive (GLTI) performance shares and Market Value Share Options (MVSO) to PDMRs, including the CEO and CFO, under the Vodafone Global Incentive Plan. Awards vest on 30 July 2029, subject to employment and performance conditions including adjusted free cash flow and ESG targets. No consideration was paid. This is a routine equity compensation disclosure, not a special situation. What to watch: none; no strategic or structural event.
